question:
Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

Confirm or support something
solution:
The correct answer is "**Corroborate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meaning of the given sentence asked in the question :
 
• **Confirm or support something:** To give evidence or testimony to the truth or factualness (सत्य या तथ्यात्मकता का प्रमाण या गवाही देना). 
 
 
• Example: *The award **confirmed **her status as one of the great movie actresses.*
 
 
 
• One word substitution of the given sentence: **"Authenticate, Corroborate, Substantiate__"**
 
• From the given options, let's understand the meaning of the marked option:
 
• **Corroborate**(Verb): To support a statement, idea, etc. by providing new evidence (पुष्ट करना).
 __
 
• Example: *Recent research seems to **corroborate **his theory.*
 
 
 
• ​From the above-listed meanings, we can say that option 2 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Collaborate:** to work together (with somebody), especially to create or produce something (किसी के साथ काम करना; से सहयोग करना, विशेषतः सृजन या उत्‍पादन कार्य में)
 
• **Cooperate: **to be helpful by doing what somebody asks you to do (अपने हिस्‍से का काम करके सहायता करना; सहयोग करना)
 
• **Consider: **to think about something carefully, often before making a decision ((निर्णय लेने से पहले) किसी बात पर सावधानी से विचार करना; सोचना)
